note: Create Room demo (lane E). One fictional character ('Ava', invented for the demo, not a real person) described in words, then built by the real person_model job (scripts/che_gpu_face_preview.py --model) in three styles, plus three customised variants of the photoreal build. Each entry is the job's --settings file. Body changes go through the job's existing FACE setting, which applies any MakeHuman/MPFB2 target by name (tools/avatar_body/mpfb_body.py); the app's own body sliders are lane A/B work.
description: Ava, a fictional woman in her early thirties: warm brown skin, dark brown hair, green-brown eyes, friendly round face, terracotta long-sleeved top, charcoal trousers.
